title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
authors: P. Lewis, E. Perez, A. Piktus, et al. (12 authors)
before: A model's knowledge was whatever got baked into its weights during training.
problem: Baked-in knowledge goes stale, cannot be audited, and cannot cite a source.
breakthrough: Retrieve passages with a dense retriever and condition a BART generator on them, training both together.
why: It named and popularised the pattern that most production LLM systems now use.
next: RETRO scaled retrieval to trillions of tokens; the whole vector-database industry followed.
inherits: Retrieval plus generation as the default answer to stale and unsourced knowledge.
